config.customBio: Hello, my name is Yatharth Richhariya. I have completed my BBA in Business Intelligence and Analytics from LNCT University, Bhopal. I have a strong foundation in Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and data analytics, along with a keen interest in AI and Machine Learning. I am a quick learner with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and I aim to build my career in the technology and AI domain.
